heroSummary: LAUSD's 2026–27 calendar begins August 12—two days earlier than in 2025–26—and lists June 4 as the last day of instruction instead of June 10. Spring Recess moves to March 22–26 from the prior year's March 30–April 3 window. Individual schools may use January 11 as a pupil-free day and make June 7 instructional, while charter and program calendars can follow separate schedules.

whatsNew.title: What's Different in 2026–2027
content: School starts two days earlier: Wednesday, August 12 instead of August 14.
Spring Recess shifts from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.
The district calendar’s listed last day moves from June 10 to June 4. Schools that use January 11 as a pupil-free day use June 7 as an instructional day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does LAUSD start and end school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: LAUSD’s first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and the published last day of instruction is Friday, June 4, 2027. LAUSD notes one exception: a school that selects January 11 as a pupil-free day uses Monday, June 7, 2027, as an instructional day. Families should confirm minimum days and campus-specific end-of-year schedules with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is LAUSD Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: LAUSD Spring Recess runs from Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. That gives students five weekdays away from school, in addition to the surrounding weekends. The next regular weekday is Monday, March 29. Families should still check their school’s calendar for campus events, early dismissals, or program-specific schedules around the recess.

calendarFaqs.q: When is LAUSD Winter Recess in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: LAUSD Winter Recess begins Monday, December 21, 2026, and ends Friday, January 8, 2027. The district calendar lists Monday, January 11, as the start of the second semester, although an individual school may select that date as a pupil-free day. Families should confirm their campus return date before finalizing child care or travel plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Are LAUSD students off for the full week of Thanksgiving?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Students are off Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026. LAUSD designates November 23–25 as unassigned days and November 26–27 as the Thanksgiving Holiday. Because the dates form one continuous student recess, the Key Dates table and monthly calendar show them as a single November 23–27 range.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there school in LAUSD on September 4 and September 7, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: No. LAUSD lists Friday, September 4, 2026, as Admission Day and Monday, September 7, as Labor Day, with no school on either date. The regular Saturday and Sunday between them create a four-day weekend for students. Families should check whether their campus separately schedules any activities before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there school in LAUSD on September 21, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Monday, September 21, 2026, is listed as an unassigned day with no school for students on the LAUSD instructional calendar. This closure is separate from the Admission Day and Labor Day weekend earlier in September. Parents and caregivers should plan for a weekday closure and verify any school-specific programs directly with the campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every LAUSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers LAUSD’s districtwide instructional calendar. Individual schools may publish separate minimum days, early-dismissal schedules, conferences, campus events, affiliated charter calendars, or specialized program dates. Use this page for major districtwide dates, then confirm school-level details before arranging travel, child care, or appointments.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all LAUSD students return on January 11, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: January 11, 2027, is the district calendar’s second-semester start date, but LAUSD allows a school to select that date as a pupil-free day. If a school uses that option, Monday, June 7, 2027, becomes an instructional day for that school. Parents should check the campus calendar or contact the school office to confirm which schedule applies.
